nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; used for access control on privileged functions.
Pending owner nominated in nominateNewOwner and accepted in acceptOwnership.
Proxyable.messageSender holding the original caller resolved through the proxy.
PeriFinance.minterRole address allowed to call mint via messageSender.
PeriFinance.inflationMinter address allowed to call inflationalMint.
PeriFinanceToEthereum.childChainManager address intended for bridge minting.
ExternStateToken.totalSupply updated during inflationalMint.
External TokenState contract holding balances and allowances.
State.associatedContract authorized to mutate TokenState balances.
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == nominatedOwner to transfer ownership.
PeriFinance.setMinterRole: onlyOwner setter for minterRole.
PeriFinance.setinflationMinter: onlyOwner setter for inflationMinter.
PeriFinance.inflationalMint: mints PERI, updates totalSupply and disperses rewards via external calls.
PeriFinance.mint: mints balance to a user when minterRole == messageSender.
PeriFinanceToEthereum.transfer: optionalProxy + systemActive transfer of PERI.
PeriFinanceToEthereum.transferFrom: optionalProxy + systemActive delegated transfer.
ExternStateToken._internalTransfer: mutates balances through tokenState and emits Transfer.
Proxy fallback: forwards calldata and value to target using assembly call.
BasePeriFinance.emitPynthExchange: onlyExchanger event emission through proxy._emit.
PeriFinance.liquidateDelinquentAccount: calls issuer liquidation then transfers redeemed PERI.
Caller-controlled address used across access control checks and proxies.
Transaction origin; not used for authorization in the analyzed paths.
Block timestamp; no direct time-based branching present in the analyzed paths.
Raw assembly call in Proxy fallback forwarding arbitrary calldata and value to the target.
External write to TokenState.setBalanceOf executed after/around external calls.
External call to IRewardsDistribution.distributeRewards before minted minter reward is credited (reentrancy surface).
External call to issuer().liquidateDelinquentAccount returning redemption amounts used for transfers.
Parameter of setMinterRole assigned into minterRole.
Parameter of setinflationMinter assigned into inflationMinter.
Parameter of inflationalMint used in fixed-point multiplication of mintable supply.
Parameter of mint receiving the newly minted balance.
Parameter of mint determining the credited amount.
Parameter of transfer/transferFrom determining the moved amount.
Parameter of transfer/transferFrom determining the destination address.
Local in inflationalMint holding the computed mintable amount.
Local in inflationalMint holding the minter reward portion.
Local in inflationalMint holding supplyToMint minus minterReward.

edges.reason: acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == nominatedOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates setMinterRole on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates setinflationMinter.
inflationalMint requires msg.sender == inflationMinter.
mint requires minterRole == messageSender.
onlyExchanger requires msg.sender == exchanger().
optionalProxy/systemActive modifiers resolve the caller for liquidation.
optionalProxy modifier resolves the caller for transfer.
Proxy fallback stores msg.sender via target.setMessageSender.
msg.sender flows into messageSender through the proxy setter.
_newMinter is written into the minterRole state variable.
_newinflationMinter is written into the inflationMinter state variable.
_networkDebtShare is multiplied with mintable supply in fixed-point math.
inflationalMint updates totalSupply with supplyToMint.
inflationalMint mutates balances through tokenState.
External rewardsDistribution.distributeRewards is invoked before crediting the minter reward.
tokenState.setBalanceOf external write occurs around external calls.
mint performs an external tokenState.setBalanceOf write.
mint reads minterRole for its authorization check.
mint compares messageSender against minterRole.
_user receives the minted balance.
_user parameter is consumed by mint.
_amount parameter is consumed by mint.
transfer delegates balance mutation to _internalTransfer.
transferFrom delegates balance mutation to _internalTransfer.
_internalTransfer writes balances through tokenState.
nominatedOwner is read and cleared during acceptOwnership.
owner is compared against msg.sender inside onlyOwner for setMinterRole.
owner is compared against msg.sender inside onlyOwner for setinflationMinter.
issuer().liquidateDelinquentAccount external call precedes PERI redemption transfer.
liquidation transfers redeemed PERI via _transferByProxy/_internalTransfer.
Proxy fallback forwards arbitrary calldata and value through an assembly call.
transfer uses messageSender as the source account.
transferFrom uses messageSender as the spender.
to parameter determines the transfer destination.
value parameter determines the transfer amount.
supplyToMint local is derived from mintableSupply and _networkDebtShare.
minterReward local is subtracted from supplyToMint.
amountToDistribute local is credited to the rewards distribution contract.
minterRole gates mint authorization.
inflationMinter gates inflationalMint authorization.

normalization_plan.reason: _newMinter is only meaningful as the input written by setMinterRole.
_newinflationMinter is only meaningful as the input written by setinflationMinter.
_networkDebtShare is only meaningful inside inflationalMint's mint computation.
_user is only meaningful as the mint recipient.
_amount is only meaningful as the mint amount.
value is only meaningful as the transfer amount.
to is only meaningful as the transfer destination.
supplyToMint is an intermediate local of inflationalMint.
minterReward is an intermediate local of inflationalMint.
amountToDistribute is an intermediate local of inflationalMint.
